assets.description: Straight walnut/cream guest counter; solid paneled front, open rear shelves.
Walnut dough prep bench, cream stone worktop, two drawers above two doors on FRONT, plain wooden BACK; empty worktop.
Stainless refrigerated topping station with six inset colored ingredient trays, low glass sneeze guard, two refrigerated FRONT doors, plain ventilated BACK panel.
Terracotta brick dome pizza oven on square brick base, cream arched FRONT mouth with small glowing fire, wood-storage niche below, short chimney; BACK continuous brick dome/base with no openings.
Walnut cutting-and-boxing bench with butcher-block top, a recessed cutting board on top, open FRONT cubbies holding flat cream pizza boxes, plain walnut BACK.
Compact stainless sink cabinet, one deep basin and arched faucet on rear rim, two FRONT cupboard doors, solid BACK; empty basin, no loose props.
Small cream countertop stand mixer with steel bowl and walnut control knob; four actual rotational views, rear motor housing distinguishable from bowl-front. Standalone appliance, no table.
Stainless trapezoid pizza oven extraction hood with short upright exhaust flue, open dark lower intake, small FRONT controls and plain BACK. Isolated wall/ceiling fixture, no wall or oven.
Freestanding walnut pickup cabinet with six square FRONT cubbies, a few cream paper takeaway bags inside; solid paneled BACK. Flat top, no countertop beneath, no labels.
Tall narrow sage drinks cooler with one transparent FRONT glass door displaying three rows of colorful drink bottles and brass handle; BACK has black condenser grille, sides solid sage.
Two-seat sage upholstered waiting bench, low walnut arms and simple legs, one cream cushion. FRONT shows seat cushions; BACK shows plain walnut backing.
Small sage cash register with cream square keys and dark display on FRONT, walnut cash drawer below, plain sage BACK with small customer display; standalone, no counter.
Two-seat sage tufted restaurant booth module, walnut plinth, no arms, tall straight upholstered backrest. FRONT shows seat cushion and tufting; BACK plain walnut panel. No table.

Single compact modular ninety-degree inner CORNER sage restaurant booth seat with two perpendicular upholstered backrests and walnut plinth, no loose pillows or table. Four genuine rotations; two backrest planes visibly change with orientation.
One walnut bentwood dining chair, sage upholstered seat, four slender legs, curved open loop backrest. Four genuine orientations: TOP row seating front visible, BOTTOM row backs of backrests visible.
Small square walnut dining table with one sturdy central pedestal and four splayed feet, EMPTY tabletop, tiny cream napkin folded near one corner as rotation cue. Four consistent rotations.
Walnut dining sideboard with two FRONT cupboard doors and drawers, two clear water carafes and three glasses on top, plain walnut BACK. Contents remain attached to top in every view.
Narrow walnut used-dish return cabinet with recessed grey bus tub in top and two FRONT open shelves with neatly stacked cream dishes; solid BACK panel.

Sage metal wire shelving bay with three levels: flour sacks bottom, tomato cans middle, cream pizza boxes top. Open FRONT, X-shaped metal cross-braces on BACK. Same load seen from four sides, no loose ground items.
Cream commercial chest freezer with closed hinged lid, small horizontal FRONT handle and black feet, BACK hinge rail and small vent. No open variants.
Cream rectangular wheeled food storage bin with sloped closed lid, recessed FRONT grip, subtle flour grain icon on FRONT only, four dark casters; plain BACK.
Rust red two-wheel hand truck, empty, curved handles, narrow steel frame, low toe plate on FRONT and two black rubber wheels at rear. Four real rotations; no crates.
Small round sage metal bistro table with simple radial lattice tabletop and three sturdy metal feet; EMPTY, no umbrella or chairs.
Sage metal patio chair with walnut horizontal seat/back slats and thin dark metal frame, four legs. Four real rotations with rear-facing backs on bottom row.

Sage-and-cream striped eight-panel patio umbrella, slim centered brass pole and small heavy round bronze ground base, no table/chairs. Four rotations consistent stripes and fixed upper-left light; canopy no larger than 2 tiles.
Long low rectangular terracotta planter divider with three compact green herb shrubs, pale sage leaf motif only on FRONT, plain terracotta BACK; same plants and container in four rotations.
One low freestanding wrought-iron fence section between two narrow terracotta brick end posts, brass post caps, repeating vertical bars, no gate, no floor. Four rotations, same construction.

Sage-and-cream striped retractable fabric awning with scalloped FRONT valance and two walnut/metal BACK mounting brackets, standalone wall-mounted fixture, no wall or building. Bottom row shows rear mounting beam rather than repeated front.
Single tall sage metal staff locker, FRONT door with vents and brass handle on right, flat solid BACK with seam, four short feet. One locker only.

Walnut office desk, left three-drawer pedestal and right open knee space on FRONT, solid modesty panel on BACK, small cream ledger on desktop. No chair or monitor attached, drawer layout preserved across true rotations.
Compact two-seat rust upholstered sofa with walnut short feet and arms, one cream striped pillow. FRONT seat cushions visible, BACK plain rust upholstered back panel, same pillow rotates with sofa.
Small walnut staff kitchenette cabinet with cream mini-fridge FRONT door below, cream electric kettle and two mugs on top, plain wooden BACK with small cable slot.

Standalone walnut-framed rectangular service pass window module with wide open transparent center, cream stone sill projecting from FRONT and slender plain BACK trim, no wall panel, no building. Four rotations; whole surrounding area and opening fully transparent.
